scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:wait: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npx --yes wait-on -t 180000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health && npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.audit:full: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.clean:install: rimraf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
